fixture: test-packs/1.6.0/fixtures/regression-reference.graph.json and regression.csv, previously imported as an independent Graph in TP08
observations: The installed independent Notes Check APK retained the eight original point rows. Linear regression reported n=8, excluded=0, df=6, residual SD 0.23094011 and centered/scaled equation equivalent to y=2*x+1.

Native folder-picker saves of CSV, HTML, SVG and PNG each reported Saved and verified. All four final artifacts have the same publication snapshot ID; SVG metadata contains three analysis tables and PNG iTXt contains the snapshot ID.

The CSV has eight sampled source point rows and three analysis tables with 155 analysis rows, including eight residual rows and 129 fitted-curve rows. Its summary reports SSE 0.31999999999999906, confidence 0.95 and pointwise mean-response/new-observation interval semantics.

At x=3.5, fitted y=8, 95% mean interval [7.800210483970861, 8.19978951602914] and 95% new-observation interval [7.400631451912581, 8.59936854808742]. At x=0 and x=7, all four bounds agree with the independent Student-t/OLS reference calculation to better than 3e-15. Prediction limits are wider than mean limits at each checked x.

The HTML report has a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, inline SVG, source hash, method, caveats, labelled analysis tables and row_8. It opened from local storage in Android HTML Viewer and Chrome. Chrome still displayed the report after Wi-Fi and mobile data were disabled; both radios were restored to their original on state.
Chrome's print preview rendered an 11-page A4 document including provenance, limits, plot and analysis tables. The preview was exited without submitting a print job.

Saved capture recipe JSON has the same snapshot ID, the same source hash and an eight-row external point-table reference. It declares completeness external-point-tables-required and says the recipe does not embed row or result bytes. Presentation mode opened and Exit presentation restored the normal Graph controls.

The 659-line scoped app-process log had no filtered fatal exception, AndroidRuntime, React Native JS error, ANR or fatal-signal match. ADB disconnected once after the HTML save; the owner reconnected it and the test continued.
scope: Physical TP11 publication pass for this debug-signed Samsung Notes Check APK. The artifacts are static publications, not editable Graph checkpoints; the capture recipe requires separately transferred point-table rows. No physical printer job, second device or internal/release signing check was performed.
